name: Devon LeClair
source:
As a child, Main Character was shown to be very adventurous and fun-loving, seeming to believe in the supernatural. As Main Character matured, they shrugged off their frightening experiences and believed that Mr. Red was only a figment of their imagination due to the grief of Jane's passing.
